remarks: Spacious and inviting 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condominium offering a practical layout and easy living. The main level features hardwood flooring, a bright living and dining area, and sliding glass doors that open to a private deck overlooking the grounds. The kitchen provides ample cabinet and counter space, while generous closets, attic storage, and an in-unit washer and dryer add everyday convenience. Central air conditioning ensures year-round comfort. Residents enjoy access to the community's in-ground pool, along with reserved and visitor parking. Conveniently located and thoughtfully maintained, this rental offers a comfortable lifestyle in a desirable community setting.
